verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate and execute software development workflows in the repository, alongside CI/CD, so a workflow automation engine clearly exists. However, nothing in the pack mentions scheduling, recurring triggers, or cron-style execution, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled or recurring triggers (e.g. cron syntax), documentation of scheduling Copilot agent tasks on a recurring basis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
